is a 6 column, 6 rows slot with spinning reels and connecting paylines originating from all 4 sides of the game grid. Central game features are the Nitro Reels which can be upgraded, the four Feature Screens that trigger features randomly, the Nitro Insane feature and the Free Spins Bonus Game.

Three or more bonus symbols anywhere on the game grid trigger the Bonus Game.

X-iter rules
The X-iter feature offers several different game modes.
Super Bonus:
One spin with guaranteed entry to the Super Bonus Game where all Nitro Reels are kept sticky at the cost of __X05_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet.
Bonus Game:
One spin with guaranteed entry to the Bonus Game where each free spin starts with a Nitro Insane feature at the cost of __X04_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet.
Nitro Insane plus Feature:
One spin with guaranteed trigger of the Nitro Insane feature and one random Feature Screen at the cost of __X03_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet.
Nitro Insane:
One spin with guaranteed trigger of the Nitro Insane feature at the cost of __X02_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet.

After years of living as outcasts in the wild outside of the city, the Pug Thugs are back in their airship, dominating the skies above the skyline. Exploiting their air supremacy, the Pug Thugs are constantly watching. Constantly searching. They see everything that is going on in the city below. When the Nitro Wolf is up to something, the Pug Thugs are the first to know. And knowledge is power.
